30 October 2026. Root construction. Mathematical reduction; independent whole
challenge pending. **Conditional computational barrier, not a hardness proof.**
No quantum device, source or cryptographic solver has run. Existing frozen
ROOT25/26 results are unchanged.

## A small-description structured source

Let s be an unknown n-bit string and 0<eta<1/2 a fixed known noise rate. Set
D_eta=(1-eta) id+eta Ad_Z and define the qubit-input channel

    N_s(rho) = 2^-n sum_y |y><y| tensor
                   Z^(s dot y) D_eta(rho) Z^(s dot y).             (1)

The dot product is binary. This is an unknown Clifford encoding with arbitrary
mixed junk, in the particularly simple case of maximally mixed n-qubit junk,
followed by logical phase noise. The Clifford consists of at most n controlled-Z
gates, controlled by the junk bits. The public output split is flag y plus one
physical qubit. Its ideal eta=0 version is exactly reversible. The actual eta>0
channel has optimal entanglement fidelity 1-eta, proved below. Its mean output
is the full maximally mixed state of dimension 2^(n+1); no small effective-rank
promise is implied. Its circuit has only O(n) classical description bits.

The native source supplies arbitrary forward uses of (1), including coherent
INPUTS, inputs entangled with retained registers, adaptivity, and interleaving.
It supplies neither a coherent output flag, an inverse dilation, an environment,
nor intervention on y. All calls are independent uses of the same channel.

## Exact simulation from classical random examples

algorithm exactly. Induction over its intervening completely positive maps
proves the full interactive statement. Quantum inputs do not turn this
classically sampled flag into a coherent example oracle.

# Repeating a random environment removes the parity acquisition barrier

30 October 2026. Root construction, using ordinary denoising and binary linear
algebra. This is an explicit SOURCE UPGRADE, not an operation claimed available
from the iid native channel. No apparatus is changed or physical experiment run.

Use the source family in NATIVE_NOISY_PARITY.md, with the same hidden n-bit s,
fixed eta<1/2, public classical flag y, and independently refreshed phase noise.
Permit one additional operation: BEGIN draws an independent uniform y and
holds that random environment fixed for r consecutive logical-input calls;
each returned output carries the same y. END releases it. The learner cannot
choose y. Holding the environment and refreshing the independent noise are
separate assumptions. A fixed error bit across the whole block would NOT work.

Choose

    m = n + ceil(log2(2/delta)),
    odd r >= 2 log(2m/delta)/(1-2eta)^2.                         (1)

For each of m independent blocks, submit |+> r times, measure X and majority
vote the r output bits. Store its public y and majority label. Each label is
wrong with probability at most exp[-r(1-2eta)^2/2]<=delta/(2m), by Hoeffding.
Thus all stored equations y dot s=label are correct except with probability
delta/2. Independently, the m by n uniform binary coefficient matrix fails
to have column rank n with probability less than 2^(n-m)<=delta/2: for each
nonzero z, Pr(all y dot z=0)=2^-m, then union bound over 2^n-1 choices.

Gaussian elimination now obtains s with success at least 1-delta. It also
checks rank and consistency; a failure can return an explicit ABORT. Rank and
consistency alone do not certify correctness if every label is adversarially
flipped to another parity. Their probabilistic guarantee comes from the
stated independent noise and uniform independent blocks, not from a checksum.

The full bill is m*r upgraded logical source calls, m environment holds, and

bit xors and O(mn) stored bits). Only one prepared logical qubit is needed at
a time in calibration; no unknown payload waits for calibration and no quantum

access scopes below. I whole-read all three source proofs and reconstructed
their mathematical chains. No root source, toy simulation, quantum circuit,
or producer receiver was rerun. ROOT_REVIEW_INPUTS.json binds the exact bytes.
Root's constructive overlap with A is disclosed: the scalable proof uses A's
coherent coset projection, and root supplied the adaptive reference hyperplane
and ideal Pauli-rigidity refinements. This is a substantive challenge of that
composition, not an independent discovery or independently implemented source.

## 1. Full-source noisy-parity reduction

Input: NATIVE_NOISY_PARITY.md. For a fixed unknown s and known0<eta<1/2,

    N_s(rho)=2^-n sum_y |y><y| tensor
                     Z^(s.y) D_eta(rho) Z^(s.y).

by preparing the CLASSICAL flag and applying the known Z^b. This equality is
complete, including retained references. Replacing each adaptive channel slot
therefore gives the full interactive simulation; no restriction to product
or predetermined inputs was introduced. Conversely a |+> input and output X
measurement produce one LPN example. Quantum logical inputs do not supply
coherent environment access or an inverse state-preparation unitary.
